row: V S Physiotherapy Osteopathy Chiropractic Lucknow

VS Physiotherapy Osteopath and Chiropractic Clinic Lucknow, founded by Dr. Venkatesh Mishra is a Physiotherapist Chiropractor and Osteopath. He did his BPT studies from Agra University and Post graduation in Musculoskeletal Disorder from HNB Gharwal University (Dehradun). Although done the Diplomate in osteopathic manipulative theory & practice from Osteopathic college of Ontario, Canada and Master in Osteopathy From JNU and Master of Chiropractic From Stockholm Sweden He is a Certified Manual Therapist, holds certificates in Taping, Pilates, Core Stability, Mulligan, MFR, Maitland, Osteopathy, PNF.
At V S Physiotherapy Osteopathy & Chiropractic Clinic, we specialize in non-invasive musculoskeletal treatments to provide safe and effective relief. Located in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India, we follow international standards in clinical physiotherapy with advanced assessment, diagnosis, and treatment techniques.
For more details or appointment call 7007932170
